title: Grilled Sausage with Potatoes and Green Beans
description: Grilled sausage and vegetables are easy to cook on the grill in a foil packet — perfect for camping or a crowd-pleasing summer meal!
ingredients: 0.75 pound fresh green beans, trimmed and halved
1 pound smoked sausage, cut into 1 inch pieces

steps.text: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat.

Place green beans, red potatoes, onion, and sausage on a large sheet of foil. Season with salt and pepper, sprinkle with oil, and top with butter. Tightly seal foil around the ingredients, leaving only a small opening. Pour water into the opening, and seal.
Place foil packet on the preheated grill. Cook 20 to 30 minutes, turning once, until sausage is browned and vegetables are tender.

video.description: When summer arrives, it’s time to ditch the crockpot and crank on the grill. You’ll love this twist on the classic indoor meal, which requires only that you place all your ingredients inside foil packets to slow-roast. Inside the foil place green beans along with red potatoes, sliced onion, smoked sausage, salt and pepper, oil, butter, and finally some water for steaming action. Cook until meat is browned and veggies are tender, and enjoy the great flavors in the great outdoors, or right in your backyard.
